name: Residual Vector Quantization (R-VQ)
aliases: Residual Vector Quantization for Scale and Rotation
definition: A method to compactly represent scale and rotation attributes of Gaussians using a learned codebook via Residual Vector Quantization (R-VQ), exploiting the limited variations in geometric attributes.
summary: Residual Vector Quantization is a lossy compression technique that represents 3D Gaussian scale and rotation by decomposing quantization error across multiple stages, achieving higher precision than standard vector quantization.
